A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same REFINE study and provide readable text, equations, tables, and figures. All pages were inspected, including v4's Appendices A-D; v1 ends with references and has no appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original multimodal benchmark evaluations, feedback-component ablations, and efficiency measurements in Tables 1-3 and Figure 2.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results and adds a detailed example showing model responses before and after retrieved feedback.

M1.justification: The three feedback stages, task/process filtering, multimodal Error-book, and single-nearest-neighbor inference remain unchanged. Section 3.2 identifies the teacher as the classifier, and Appendices B-C document pseudocode and prompts; these disclosures do not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same MME-RealWorld reasoning domains, MMStar Instance/Logical Reasoning, and SEED-Bench-2-Plus Chart/Map/Web tasks. Appendix D illustrates the existing visual-counting setting without expanding dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1-2 retain Standard Prompting, CoT, Direct Feedback, and RICP for both student models across the same benchmarks. Figure 2 retains the same efficiency comparators.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the student and teacher models, temperature 0.0, pass@1 evaluation, and dataset-splitting procedures. Appendix A newly discloses Error-book and test counts without reporting revised splits or sample sizes.

E4.justification: Appendix D expands the schematic counting illustration into a detailed case with the question, retrieved feedback, original incorrect response, and corrected response. The controlled self-regulatory, clustering, and CoT ablations in Section 4.3 and Table 3 remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for the experiments. The added dataset counts are not repeated-run information.

E6.justification: Tables 1-3 and Figure 2 retain their results, including REFINE's MME-RealWorld overall accuracies of 41.92 and 32.12. Appendix D newly reports a detailed response pair: answer D (3), marked wrong, followed by answer C (0), marked correct. This is a limited qualitative addition.

T1.justification: Equations 1-3 retain the same Error-book construction, cosine-similarity retrieval, and enhanced prompt. Appendix B restates the procedure as pseudocode without introducing new mathematical assumptions, theoretical results, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about structured error feedback, accuracy, efficiency, and generalization. The reported speedup and token-saving claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations involving feedback specificity, overload, model capacity, clustering noise, and knowledge gaps remain unchanged, as does the Limitations paragraph. Appendix D illustrates the existing pose-definition correction rationale without introducing a broader interpretation or limitation.

D1.justification: v4 substantially expands reproducibility information: Section 3.2 explains automated teacher-based classification, Appendix B provides pseudocode, and Appendix C supplies all three feedback prompts with output constraints. Appendix A adds Error-book/test counts of 534/2,092, 123/250, and 563/1,141 for the three benchmarks. These are documentation additions rather than demonstrated experimental changes.

R1.justification: The related-work sections and bibliography retain the same works and positioning against LEAP, TRAN, RICP, and retrieval-based approaches. Section 3.2 repeats the already-cited Hattie and Timperley attribution.

P1.justification: Prose changes are localized to the filtering explanation, an appendix cross-reference, and author affiliation/contact information. Appendices A-D organize added supporting documentation, while the main section sequence and nearly all narrative text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v4 adds a substantial set of appendix displays: dataset-statistics Table 4, Algorithm 1, three styled prompt panels, and an illustrated before/after response panel. Existing Figures 1-2 retain identical artwork, while the main results tables and efficiency figure are repositioned within the text.

improvement.justification: v4 makes the work easier to reproduce and inspect through explicit feedback prompts, classifier details, dataset counts, and pseudocode. The quantitative evidence remains unchanged. The added example has an inconsistent retrieved-feedback count—two qualifying people plus two tricycles described as totaling two—which limits its value as validation, but the documentation gains support a modest overall improvement.
